title: When Recursive Models Finish Computing
abstract: arXiv:2609.26487v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Recursive models can continue updating their latent states beyond their nominal inference budget, so an incorrect output at that budget does not show whether computation is unfinished or has entered a persistently unsuccessful regime. We study the dynamics of completion in attention- and MLP-based Tiny Recursive Models (TRMs) on 1,000 hard Sudoku puzzles. Extending recurrence from the nominal 16 steps to 512 steps increases cumulative exact-solve accuracy from 59.2% to 87.5% for the attention model and from 74.4% to 91.9% for the MLP model, solving more than two-thirds of the puzzles unsolved in the nominal budget. Across both architectures, latent-state motion drops sharply after the first exact solution. Completed states are typically locally contractive along the trajectory direction, even though the same local Jacobian retains strongly expanding directions. translated_title: 递归模型何时完成计算
translated_abstract: 递归模型可以在其标称推理预算之外继续更新其潜在状态，因此在该预算下产生的错误输出无法表明计算是尚未完成，还是已经进入一种持续不成功的状态。我们研究了基于注意力和基于MLP的微型递归模型（TRMs）在1000道困难数独谜题上的完成动力学。将递归从标称的16步扩展到512步后，注意力模型的累计精确求解准确率从59.2%提高到87.5%，MLP模型从74.4%提高到91.9%，解决了标称预算下未能求解的谜题中超过三分之二的部分。在两种架构中，潜在状态的运动在首次得到精确解之后都会急剧下降。已完成的状态通常沿轨迹方向呈现局部收缩性，即使相同的局部雅可比矩阵仍保留着强烈的扩张方向。我们将这一现象刻画为轨迹条件下的各向异性稳定性（原文在此处截断）。
tldr: 该研究通过将微型递归模型（TRM）的递归步数从标称的16步扩展到512步，显著提升了困难数独求解准确率（注意力模型从59.2%升至87.5%，MLP模型从74.4%升至91.9%），并将“计算完成”现象刻画为轨迹条件下的各向异性稳定性——潜在状态在首次获得精确解后运动骤降并沿轨迹方向局部收缩。
en_tdlr: By extending recurrence from the nominal 16 steps to 512 steps, Tiny Recursive Models dramatically improve hard Sudoku accuracy (attention: 59.2%→87.5%; MLP: 74.4%→91.9%), and the paper characterizes computational completion as trajectory-conditioned anisotropic stability, where latent-state motion drops sharply after the first exact solution.
